auth.v1.ApiKey.description: ApiKey is public API key metadata. It never includes the private key or seed.

color.description: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.
color.title: color

createdAt.description: Time in UTC when this key was created.
createdAt.title: created_at

createdByActor.description:
Read-only actor label describing who created this key, such as a username
 or account label.
createdByActor.title: created_by_actor

expiresAt.description:
Optional expiry time in UTC. When set, the key cannot authenticate requests
 after this time, regardless of status.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

icon.description: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.
icon.title: icon

ipWhitelist.description:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

items.description:
value must be a valid IP prefix
value is empty, which is not a valid IP prefix

ipWhitelist.title: ip_whitelist

keyId.description:
Stable opaque identifier used to refer to this key, formatted as "ak_"
 followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.
keyId.title: key_id

label.description: Human-readable label for the key. Maximum length is 64 characters.
label.title: label

lastUsedAt.description:
Approximate last time in UTC when this key authenticated a request,
 recorded at most about once a minute; it may lag recent use by a few
 minutes. Omitted when no use has been recorded.
lastUsedAt.title: last_used_at

policyId.description:
Optional API policy attached to this key (opaque ID).
 Empty means no policy is attached and the key has no permissions.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
policyId.title: policy_id

publicKeyEd25519.description:
Ed25519 public key bytes associated with this API key. The private key or
 seed is never returned by the API.
publicKeyEd25519.title: public_key_ed25519

purpose.description:
What the key is for. ASSISTANT keys are managed with SetAssistantKeys and
 are otherwise listed, updated and revoked like any key.
purpose.title: purpose

revision.description: Monotonic resource revision used for conditional updates.
revision.title: revision

subaccountId.description:
Optional sub-account this key is scoped to (opaque ID; empty = root-level).

Public ID, as a base58 string.
subaccountId.title: subaccount_id

updatedAt.description:
Time in UTC when this key's configuration was last changed. For the same
 key, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and earlier is stale.
 Equal timestamps with different configuration indicate an invariant failure.
 This is independent of last_used_at, which tracks authentication activity.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

auth.v1.ApiKey.title: ApiKey

auth.v1.AssistantKeySpec.description: AssistantKeySpec is one account's key in the caller's assistant key set.

policyId.description:
API policy that bounds the key (opaque ID). It must belong to the same
 main account as the key, and must not allow EXTERNAL_WITHDRAW,
 INTERNAL_TRANSFER, MANAGE_ADDRESS_BOOK or MANAGE_AUTO_WITHDRAW.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
policyId.title: policy_id

publicKeyEd25519.description:
Ed25519 public key bytes the Polyester AI assistant signs with. Must be
 exactly 32 bytes, and distinct within the set.
publicKeyEd25519.title: public_key_ed25519

registrationDeadline.description:
Time until which the key may be registered, as the Polyester AI assistant
 issued it with the key (PrepareAssistantKeys), in whole milliseconds.
 Required for a new key: it must still be ahead, and at most 15 minutes
 ahead. Not needed when the account's current assistant key already has
 this public key.
registrationDeadline.title: registration_deadline

registrationProof.description:
The key's own Ed25519 signature over the caller's account, the key's
 account, its public key and registration_deadline, as the assistant
 issued it with the key (64 bytes). Required for a new key; not needed
 when the account's current assistant key already has this public key.
registrationProof.title: registration_proof

subaccountId.description:
Sub-account the key acts for (opaque ID). Unset means the caller's main
 account. A key acts for exactly one account.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
subaccountId.title: subaccount_id

auth.v1.AssistantKeySpec.title: AssistantKeySpec

CreateApiKeyRequest creates a new API key. Clients generate the Ed25519 key
 pair locally and submit only the public key.

label.description:

 not contain '<' or '>'.

publicKeyEd25519.description:

subaccountId.description:

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DISABLED: Key is temporarily disabled and cannot authenticate requests until re-enabled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REVOKED: Key has been permanently revoked and cannot be used again.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List non-revoked API keys for the caller account, or for a sub-account the caller owns or administers, newest first. An API key needs READ_API_KEYS; a key scoped to a sub-account sees only that sub-account's keys.

parameters.description:
Optional filter: only keys scoped to this sub-account (opaque ID). The
 caller must own or administer the sub-account. If unset, only non-revoked
 keys owned by the caller are returned.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
parameters.name: subaccountId

schema.description:
Optional filter: only keys scoped to this sub-account (opaque ID). The
 caller must own or administer the sub-account. If unset, only non-revoked
 keys owned by the caller are returned.
schema.title: subaccount_id

post.description: Create a new API key for the caller account, including public key material and metadata. Requires the acting caller to have accepted the current terms.

delete.description: Revoke an API key owned by the caller account. Revocation is permanent.

parameters.description:
Opaque API key identifier (e.g. "ak_<hex>"). This is the stable public
 handle for a key.

get.description: Retrieve a single API key owned by the caller account or scoped to a sub-account the caller administers. An API key needs READ_API_KEYS; a key scoped to a sub-account reads only that sub-account's keys.

parameters.description:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.
parameters.name: key_id

Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.

patch.description: Partially update API-key metadata using If-Match revision control.

parameters.description: Strong ETag revision returned by the latest read.
parameters.name: If-Match

delete.description: Revoke every Polyester AI assistant key the caller set up. Needs no step-up proof.

get.description: List the caller's non-revoked Polyester AI assistant keys, newest first.

put.description: Create or replace the caller's Polyester AI assistant key set with one fresh step-up proof. All keys change or none do; accounts left out lose their assistant key.
